title: Normalised email identity shared with the companion mail app
spec: Implement identity::normalize_email exactly as its doc comment says, by hand over ASCII bytes (no regex, no new dependencies). Trim with str::trim, then refuse any byte that is not ASCII graphic; split on '@' (exactly one); check the local part's allowed characters and dot rules and the MAX_LOCAL length; check the domain's MAX_DOMAIN length, at least two labels, each 1 to 63 characters of letters, digits and '-' not at either end; return the whole address lowercased with to_ascii_lowercase.
